correctness.rationale: Proved via Beta-Gamma independence after conditioning on the sum of any pair, exact symmetric interval constraints for the pair, strict folded-Beta MLR in shape imbalance with positive-probability strictness, and finite balancing transfers. The exact epsilon asymptotic follows by conditioning on unique minimum, a uniform Gamma-density domination and explicit Gamma integral. A standard-library exact rational checker corroborated 306 finite profile comparisons, including 216 strict ones and 108 independent two-agent beta reductions; finite checking is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural fixed-before-revelation fairness risk problem is solved at every finite multiplicative envy factor, for any n and m and arbitrary positive Gamma item shape. Unique balancing of bundle sizes emerges as a structural all-tolerance guarantee, overcoming integer divisibility. The sharp near-tolerance coefficient gives a finite-sample performance scale and an exact occupancy-probability interpretation for exponential goods; these are not mere reparameterizations of a tabulated distribution.
